incident: Search service wrong feature flag causes empty results
symptoms: search returned empty results for 20% of users
issue began immediately after flag rollout
recent_changes: See root-cause context; synthetic historical incident.
root_cause: A ranking experiment flag selected an index alias that did not exist in production.
resolution: A feature flag selected a nonexistent search index alias. Disabling the flag restored results.
postmortem: Timeout tuning did not address the invalid alias.
